# SQL Warehouses Overview
Source: https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/compute/sql-warehouse/
Fetched: 2026-06-16
Last updated on page: Jan 8, 2026

## Connect to a SQL warehouse
"A SQL warehouse is a compute resource that lets you query and explore data on Databricks."

## Use SQL warehouses
"The SQL warehouses you have access to appear in the compute drop-down menus of workspace UIs."
"Running a query against a stopped warehouse starts it automatically if you have access to the warehouse."
"To help you get started, Databricks creates a small SQL warehouse called Starter Warehouse automatically."
Auto-start triggers: running a query, scheduled jobs, JDBC/ODBC connections, or associated dashboards opening.

## What are Serverless SQL warehouses?
"Databricks SQL delivers optimal price and performance with serverless SQL warehouses."
"Databricks recommends using serverless SQL warehouses when available."
Three advantages:
1. "Instant and elastic compute" — "Eliminates waiting for infrastructure resources and avoids resource over-provisioning during usage spikes."
2. "Minimal management overhead" — "Capacity management, patching, upgrades, and performance optimization are all handled by Databricks."
3. "Lower total cost of ownership (TCO)" — "Automatic provisioning and scaling of resources as needed helps avoid over-provisioning and reduces idle times."

## Start a SQL warehouse
CAN MONITOR permission required to manually start a stopped warehouse.
"To manually start a stopped SQL warehouse, click the SQL Warehouses icon in the sidebar."

## Create a SQL warehouse
"Configuring and launching SQL warehouses requires elevated permissions generally restricted to an administrator."
"Unity Catalog governs data access permissions on SQL warehouses for most assets. Administrators configure most data access permissions."

## Warehouse sizing and autoscaling behavior
Detailed sizing, scaling, and queuing behavior covered in separate linked docs for classic and pro warehouses.

## SQL warehouses and third-party BI tools
"Databricks SQL supports many third party BI and visualization tools that can connect to SQL warehouses."
Mentioned: Power BI, Tableau.

## Developer tools for SQL warehouses
REST API, CLI, Python SQL Connector, SQLTools Driver for VS Code, DataGrip, DBeaver, SQL Workbench/J.

## SQL warehouses vs SQL endpoints
"SQL endpoints were renamed as SQL warehouses in 2023."
"SQL warehouses and SQL endpoints both refer to a type of SQL-optimized compute resource."
